claim: On 25 July 2019, Paris’s ERA5 grid cell recorded a daily maximum of 41.4 °C—the hottest of 27,759 days in the 1950–2025 record. It also ranked first among the 76 annual hottest-day values, exceeding the 1991–2020 mean annual TXx of 34.8 °C by 6.6 °C.
reason: Source states 41.4 °C on 2019-07-25, rank 1 of 27,759 days, rank 1 of 76 annual values, baseline mean TXx 34.8 °C, +6.6 °C. All stated.
